title: The Security Growth Platform: Why MSPs Are Moving Beyond vCISO Tools
summary: Three years ago, the practical question for an MSP building a cybersecurity practice was which "vCISO platform" to buy. The term was good shorthand for the work at the time: assessments, advisory, reporting, maybe a compliance module bolted on the side. The work has since outgrown the descriptor.

title: Critical WP Maps Pro Flaw Actively Exploited to Create Admin Accounts
summary: Threat actors are attempting to actively exploit a critical security flaw impacting WP Maps Pro, a WordPress plugin that has had over 15,000 sales on the Envato Market, to create malicious administrator accounts on susceptible sites.
